coordinatorProcessObservation.provenance: Coordinator reported CLOSED0; raw independently reconciled to one start, twelve completed countries and the final result JSON. Reviewer did not rerun the policy.

scope: Separate criminal-life policyv2, fixed reused country seeds900..911. Real in-memory SQLite/store creation+birth acknowledgement only; all later state changes use immutable normal pure-engine commands. Ordinary school, one exact-state/RNG compulsory leave guard and one below-minimum voluntary withdrawal guard when available. Before later work/crime, attempt bound voluntary secondary withdrawal at the first eligible normal free/planning window after pending events; actual currentSchool/schoolWithdrawalReason and authored minimum apply, without advancing a date to force eligibility. Only a real schoolWithdrawals record credits schoolExit; ordinary schoolCompletions remain separate. Healthy routine and real eligible work; no child offences. At most3 actual nonviolent offences one/year after max(18,countryadult,schoolEnd), in fixed shoplift/pickpocket/burglary order, stopping new crime at35; pickpocket requires an actual known available nonrelative adult victim and all actual skill/health gates apply. Even-index countries post actually affordable bail, odd stay on remand; private counsel once only if quoted fee+3months local living reserve is affordable, else public. Always plead not-guilty without inspecting any hidden detection/investigation/trial/appeal roll. Actual planning pauses allow prison work/study/exercise/quiet routine, one actual prison friendship and available parent visit; direct custody job/study/travel guards retain exact state/RNG. Hospital/discharge months cannot earn prison pay/study. Real releases, reemployment, regulated-job current-record blocks, actual work-abroad application offers without moving, one affordable1month holiday and actual record expiry; eligible retirement and natural death/conserved estate. Genuine acquittals, unavailable stages and early death remain explicit. Holiday travel has current custody/pursuit/court gates, not an invented conviction ban. Cold checks use actual automatic-save packCheckpoint/unpackCheckpoint with whole canonical-world equality and frame sizes, not the smaller plain-import decoder limit. No source limits changed. Only birth uses actual SQLite/store; remainder is not full-journeySQLite/native/physical-performance/contraband-seizure/multigeneration/Scenario A/C acceptance, not additional distinct seeds in the existing120 annual-policy total, and not complete Scenario B merely because a policy run ends or school withdrawal is reached; all actual missing milestones remain reported.
observationEncoding: Array/object hashes use recursive key-sorted UTF-8 JSON, compact separators, unescaped Unicode; original decimal monetary strings remain strings. Raw input file hashes cover original bytes. Negative group occurrences encode [raw observation index, age, year, month, day] under each record allObservations pointer. Indexed negative hash covers [{index,observation}] in original order. Every unreached object is copied exactly. All other scene results remain in the whole hash-pinned observations array; commitment and choice ID are never interpreted as success.
honestObservations: All twelve actual withdrawals occur at the frozen V1 authored minimum: seven age16, two age17, two age15 and India age14. These are game rules, not national-law claims.
Italy has two real acquittals, no conviction or sentence, and sixteen unreached milestones at natural death age45. Post-release travel/work branches were not taken without a real release.
Britain paid for a real holiday that was interrupted with zero attended trip periods; holidayCompleted stays unreached.
France died naturally at52; retirement remains unreached. US and Japan have no delayed-arrest milestone.

Seven countries reach all26 policy milestone labels, but that does not establish complete Scenario B acceptance. Holiday has current custody/pursuit/court gates; this policy does not invent a blanket conviction travel ban.
Production packCheckpoint chooses v1 for eight small childhood worlds and v4 for404 other checks; all twelve final frames are v4. Configured checkpointv4 does not mean every production frame uses v4.

Only birth and acknowledgement use SQLite/store; later commands and exact production-checkpoint cold checks run in memory. No native, physical, full-journey SQLite, contraband/seizure, Scenario A/C or multigeneration acceptance, and no additional annual-policy seeds, are claimed.
